entities.name: Rex Nebula
entities.description: Human, self-proclaimed greatest captain in the universe and terrible pilot of the Astrotorium.

entities.name: Myra the Magnificent
entities.description: Owner of the Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun.

entities.name: Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun
entities.description: Giant space station piloted through the multiverse by Rex Nebula.

entities.name: Blorb-12
entities.description: Home-world of the Blorbians, destroyed by Rex.

entities.name: Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop
entities.description: Blorbian ambassador with a friendly rivalry with Rex.

events.quote: Rex is responsible for the destruction of Blorb-12 , the home-world of the Blorbians and Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop .

relations.quote: Captain Rex Nebula is a human employee who pilots Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun through the multiverse.
Nebula and the Ambassador have a friendly rivalry, sometimes even getting dinner together.
